text:
Leah: Heads-up — planning a non-busy-window deploy for inference-service v2.3.1 at 18:00 PT. Need a quick runbook + rollback sync. @Raj you own rollback, @Mike you run smokes, @Olivia backup.

Raj: Copy. Can you confirm rollback criteria and the escape hatch command? Also who is watching metrics?

Leah: Rollback criteria (proposal):
- sustained error rate > 2% for 5m OR
- p95 latency > 500ms for 5m OR
- increase in model hallucination score on smoke prompts > 20 points (we'll use the smoke prompt set).
Owners: Raj (rollback exec), Mike (smoke verification), SRE oncall monitors infra metrics.

Mike: Smoke checklist I'll run at canary start:
1) curl health endpoint
2) run 5 sample generates, compare hashes/response shape
3) check token throughput and memory on GPU nodes
4) validate fallback routing toggles

Sample commands I will use:
```bash
curl -fsS https://inference-api.redwood.prod/health | jq .
curl -sS -X POST https://inference-api.redwood.prod/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"Smoke: short completion"}' | jq .
# quick perf probe (p95)
wrk -t2 -c20 -d10s https://inference-api.redwood.prod/generate
```

Leah: Rollback/escape commands (documented in runbook):
- Toggle routing to fallback model: `infra-ctl route set inference --model=gpt-small-v1`
- Feature flag off: `ffctl set deploy.inference.v2_3_1 false`
- Kubernetes rollback (if needed): `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/inference-service --to-revision=202`
- Fast rollback script: `scripts/rollback_inference.sh --to v2.3.0 --reason "smoke-fail"`
(We keep both feature-flag and route rollback as independent escape hatches.)

Raj: Looks good. Clarify monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds so SRE knows when to call rollback:
- Errors: alerts if 5m error rate > 1.5% (pager at 2%)
- Latency: p95 > 450ms fires a warning, > 600ms paged
- Model quality: automatic regression alert if smoke set avg score drops >15

sre-oncall: I'll be on the dashboard at deploy time. Will mute non-critical alerts for the 30m watch window, but will page if thresholds hit.

Olivia: Quick note — the canary will be 10% traffic for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Configured autoscale pause during canary to avoid scale churn.

Mike: I'll post smoke results inline when canary starts. If any smoke fails I'll call rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: inference-service:v2.3.1 -> prod at 2024-06-10 18:00 PT (initiator: Leah). Canary steps enabled.

(18:00 PT) deploy-bot: Deployment started — canary 10%

Mike: Starting smoke checks now. Running health + 5 samples.

(18:03 PT) Mike: Health OK, sample shapes OK, no obvious hallucinations. Perf quick probe p95 ~ 180ms. Error rate 0.3%.

(18:12 PT) deploy-bot: Canary progressing -> 50%

Mike: Second round of smokes after 50% ramp: health OK, p95 220ms, error rate 0.4%. No quality regressions on smoke set.

sre-oncall: Infra signals stable, GPU memory normal, no node restarts. Watch window nominal.

Leah: Raj — any objections? Rollback readiness confirmed?

Raj: I'm standing by. Rollback script tested in staging earlier, keys and runbook links present. Criteria still as agreed. GO from me. :white_check_mark:

Olivia: Backup ready to execute feature flag if needed.

Leah: Great — proceeding to full rollout. If anything crosses the thresholds above, Raj will execute rollback and post reason.

(18:25 PT) deploy-bot: Rollout complete -> 100% traffic.

Mike: Final verification done, smoke set pass, production p95 210ms, error rate 0.35%.

sre-oncall: Monitoring for 30m. No anomalies right now.

Leah: Thanks all — closing this thread. Will file a short post-deploy note in #eng-releases summary channel with metrics. :rocket:
